async function smeltNineRawCopper(bot) {
    // This function ensures that at least nine copper ingots are available. It first checks if the required nine raw copper and nine coal are present. If not, it attempts to craft a crafting table, and if one isn't found, it tries to place one nearby. It then ensures a furnace exists, crafting or placing it if necessary. Finally, it smelts nine raw copper using coal to produce the required ingots.
